findings.body: The diff changes `use openhuman_core::openhuman as oh;` to `use openhuman_core as oh;`. This means all references to `oh::` in the file now path through the crate root instead of the `openhuman` module. If `openramp::openhuman` re-exports symbols that `openhuman_core` does not, or if symbols are at different paths, the code may fail to compile or silently resolve to different items. The surrounding diff context shows `oh::agent::dispatcher::...` and `oh::agent::prompts::...`, which are likely still available, but without seeing the full file or the crate's public API, this cannot be confirmed. The author should ensure the new path resolves to the same items.
